description: This file provides a helper class for interacting with the LiveKit REST API, specifically for managing LiveKit rooms such as creating access tokens and deleting rooms by name.

classes.name: LiveKitRESTHelper
classes.description: A helper class encapsulating methods for communicating with the LiveKit REST API, including room management and access token creation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the helper with API credentials and session.

methods.name: _create_access_token
methods.description: Generates a signed JWT token for authenticating with LiveKit.

methods.name: delete_room_by_name
methods.description: Deletes a room in LiveKit by name, forcibly disconnecting participants.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, api_secret: str, api_url: str = "https://your-livekit-host.com", aiohttp_session: aiohttp.ClientSession, )

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, *, api_key: str, api_secret: str, api_url: str = "https://your-livekit-host.com", aiohttp_session: aiohttp.ClientSession, )

ctags.pattern: /^    async def delete_room_by_name(self, room_name: str) -> bool:$/
